intro: SQL injection remains a persistent flaw across 13 articles published between 14 April and 26 September 2026. CVE-2026-27681, rated CVSS 9.9, leads the coverage, followed by CVE-2026-36962, CVE-2026-42208, and CVE-2026-6433, each at CVSS 9.8, and CVE-2026-34259 at CVSS 9.6. The severity mix comprises seven critical, four high, and two medium issues. Enterprise software, web hosting, e-commerce, retail, and software development rank among the most affected sectors. Reporting spans Europe, Global, and North America.
